name: PD 710
source: Dallas City Code ch. 51P, Article 710 (City Attorney's codified article, April 2026)

sections.title: Legislative History
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-710.101. LEGISLATIVE HISTORY.

PD 710 was established by Ordinance No. 25829, passed by the Dallas City Council on December 8, 2004. (Ord. 25829)

sections.title: Property Location And Size
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-710.102. PROPERTY LOCATION AND SIZE.

PD 710 is established on property located at the southeast corner of Illinois Avenue and Coombs Creek Drive. The size of PD 710 is approximately 21.136 acres. (Ord. Nos. 25829; 32313)

sections.title: Definitions And Interpretations
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-710.103. DEFINITIONS AND INTERPRETATIONS.

(a) Unless otherwise stated, the definitions and interpretations in Chapter 51A apply to this article.

(b) Unless otherwise stated, all references to articles, divisions, or sections in this article are to articles, divisions, or sections in Chapter 51A.

(c) This district is considered to be a nonresidential zoning district.

(d) MASSAGE PARLOR means an establishment as defined in Chapter 25A of the Dallas City Code.

(e) TATTOO PARLOR or TATTOO STUDIO means a premise licensed by the Texas Department of Health for the business of marking or coloring words or images on the skin with dyes or inks, but excludes markings or colorings performed for medical purposes (e.g. plastic surgery or reconstructive surgery) or for cosmetic purposes (e.g. permanent eye liner). (Ord. 25829)

SEC. 51P-710.103.1. EXHIBITS.

The following exhibits are incorporated into this article:

(1) Exhibit 710A: conceptual plan.

(2) Exhibit 710B: sign plan

(3) Exhibit 710C: property description. (Ord. 32313)

SEC. 51P-710.103.2. TRACTS.

This district is divided into two tracts (Tract I and Tract II) as shown on the conceptual plan (Exhibit 710A). A full property description for the district is provided in Exhibit 710C. (Ord. 32313)

sections.title: Conceptual Plan
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-710.104. CONCEPTUAL PLAN.

Development and use of the Property must comply with the conceptual plan (Exhibit 710A). In the event of a conflict between the text of this article and the conceptual plan, the text of this article controls. (Ord. 25829)

sections.title: Development Plan
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-710.105. DEVELOPMENT PLAN.

A development plan that complies with the conceptual plan and this article must be submitted to and approved by the city plan commission for each tract prior to the issuance of a building permit for that tract. (Ord. 25829)

sections.title: Main Uses Permitted
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-710.106. MAIN USES PERMITTED.

(a) The only main uses permitted on the Property are those main uses permitted in the CR Community Retail District (except those uses listed in Subsection (b) of this section), subject to the same conditions applicable in the CR Community Retail District, as set out in Chapter 51A. For example, a use permitted in the CR Community Retail District only by specific use permit
(SUP) is permitted in this district only by SUP; a use subject to development impact review (DIR) in the CR Community Retail District is permitted in this district only by DIR etc.

(b) The following main uses are not permitted in this district:

-- Crop production. -- Cemetery or mausoleum. -- Convent or monastery. -- Hospital. -- Hotel or motel. -- College dormitory, fraternity or sorority -- Liquor store. -- Swap or buy shop. -- Massage parlor. -- Tattoo parlor or tattoo studio. (Ord. 25829)

sections.title: Accessory Uses
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-710.107. ACCESSORY USES.

(a) As a general rule, an accessory use is permitted in any district in which the main use is permitted. Some specific types of accessory uses, however, due to their unique nature, are subject to additional regulations in Section 51A-4.217. For more information regarding accessory uses, consult Section 51A-4.217.

(b) The following accessory uses are not permitted in this district:

-- Accessory community center (private). -- Home occupation. -- Private stable.
(c) The following accessory use is permitted in this district by SUP only:

-- Accessory helistop. (Ord. 25829)

sections.title: Yard, Lot, And Space Regulations
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-710.108. YARD, LOT, AND SPACE REGULATIONS.

(Note: The yard, lot, and space regulations in this section must be read together with the yard, lot, and space regulations in Division 51A-4.400. In the event of a conflict between this section and Division 5IA-4.400, this section controls.)

(a) Front yard. Minimum front yard setback must comply with the conceptual plan.

(b) Side and rear yard. Minimum side and rear yard setback must comply with the conceptual plan.

(c) Floor area ratio. Maximum floor area ratio must comply with the conceptual plan.

(d) Height. Maximum structure height is 54 feet.

(e) Lot coverage. Maximum lot coverage is 60 percent. Aboveground parking structures are included in lot coverage calculations; surface parking lots and underground parking structures are not.

(f) Lot size. No minimum lot size.

(g) Stories. Maximum number of stories above grade is three. (Ord. 25829)

sections.title: Off-Street Parking And Loading
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-710.109. OFF-STREET PARKING AND LOADING.

(a) Consult the use regulations contained in Division 51A-4.200 for the specific off- street parking and loading requirements for each use.

(b) For purposes of off-street parking and loading, the entire district is considered as one lot. (Ord. 25829)

sections.title: Environmental Performance Standards
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-710.110. ENVIRONMENTAL PERFORMANCE STANDARDS.

See Article VI. (Ord. 25829)

sections.title: Landscaping
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-710.111. LANDSCAPING.

(a) A landscape plan must be submitted together with the development plan and be approvedby the city plan commission before any building permit authorizing work in this district

may issue.

(b) Landscaping must be provided as required by Article X.

(c) All plant materials must be maintained in a healthy, growing condition. (Ord. 25829)

sections.title: Signs
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-710.112. SIGNS.

(a) Except as otherwise provided in this section, all signs must comply with the provisions for business zoning districts in Article VII.

(b) Non-monument signs are prohibited.

(c) Only one detached multi-tenant unity-agreement monument sign is permitted with the dimensions and effective area as shown on Exhibit 710B. (Ord. Nos. 25829; 26329)

sections.title: Additional Provisions
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-710.113. ADDITIONAL PROVISIONS.

(a) The entire Property must be properly maintained in a state of good repair and neat appearance.

(b) Development and use of the Property must comply with all federal and state laws and regulations, and with all ordinances, rules, and regulations of the city. (Ord. 25829)

sections.title: Compliance With Conditions
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-710.114. COMPLIANCE WITH CONDITIONS.

(a) All paved areas, permanent drives, streets, and drainage structures, if any, must be constructed in accordance with standard city specifications and completed to the satisfaction of the director of public works and transportation.

(b) The building official shall not issue a building permit to authorize work, or a certificate of occupancy to authorize the operation of a use in this district, until there has been full compliance with this article, the Dallas Development Code, the construction codes, and all other ordinances, rules, and regulations of the city. (Ord. 25829)
